sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog (data/catalogs/walkplay.json) lists 0x3302:0x43cc "Protocol Max" under scheme 16; band count, filter types and Q and pre-gain limits as the app's editor gives them for that scheme

meta.notes:
Its recorded capture's product id is in devicePEQ's "SchemeNo16" group, whose settings apply under the device's own.
devicePEQ and Walkplay's app agree on 10 bands for this device; the app gives scheme 16 low pass and high pass filters too, where devicePEQ has peaking and shelves only. Its Q and pre-gain limits are those of Walkplay's web app, read back from a scheme 11 device: Q up to 10, as in devicePEQ, and a pre-gain of -16 to +6 dB in whole dB (devicePEQ: -128 to +127); not checked on this device.
devicePEQ's recorded capture of this device (walkplay_schemeno16_protocol_max.json) shows it holding a pre-gain of +6 dB, inside the web app's limits and outside the Android app's.
